detail.longDescription: If any of you got creative kids - years ago (pre-AI) I made a small animation maker for hand drawn doodles, much like a flip book. Then I thought a neural network would handle it better, but further on I realised classical computer vision is all you need for a well defined task. So here we go, Bunnymator! https:// bunny.zserge.com/ And a story behind it: https:// zserge.com/posts/bunnymator/ # animation # computervision # yolo # oldschoolcool # opencv # machinelearning # ai
